_meta.purpose: Generator-ready visual DNA for poster concepts. Each entry constrains an image model on six axes so output does not regress to the training-data mean. Reference by `id` from a concept's visual.style_id.

styles.name: Swiss / International Typographic
styles.composition: Strict modular grid. One enormous element (a numeral, a word, a single geometric form) occupying 40-60% of canvas. Asymmetric balance. Generous margins.
styles.typography: Neue Haas Grotesk / Helvetica / Akzidenz-Grotesk only. Flush-left ragged-right. Two sizes maximum, extreme scale contrast between them.
styles.texture: None. Absolutely flat vector. No gradient, no grain, no shadow.
styles.render_cues: flat vector Swiss International Style poster, strict modular grid, Helvetica, extreme scale contrast, one dominant geometric element, generous white margins, pure flat colour fields, no gradients

styles.name: WPA / National Park Poster
styles.composition: Low horizon or dramatic upward view. Foreground silhouette framing a landmark. Flat colour bands for depth. Title block in a rule-bounded panel at the bottom third.
styles.typography: Condensed sans or gothic caps, letterspaced. Small subtitle line beneath the main title. Sometimes a period slab serif.
styles.texture: Light screen-print grain and slight ink misregistration. Never photographic.
styles.render_cues: vintage WPA national park screen print poster, flat limited palette, layered colour bands, silhouetted foreground foliage, dramatic landscape, letterspaced condensed caps title panel, subtle screen print grain
styles.ip_note: The original WPA/NPS archive is US public domain. Do not use current NPS logos or arrowhead mark.

styles.name: Art Deco
styles.composition: Rigid bilateral symmetry. Stepped ziggurat forms. Radiating sunburst or fan. Strong vertical emphasis. Ornamental border built from repeating geometry (never a plain frame line).
styles.typography: Geometric deco caps, high-waisted, tight tracking. Often inline or with a hairline rule above and below.
styles.texture: Flat with metallic-gold accent fills. Optional fine linework.
styles.render_cues: art deco poster, rigid symmetry, stepped geometric forms, radiating sunburst, gold and deep teal, high-waisted geometric deco capitals, streamlined machine-age stylisation, flat ornamental linework

styles.name: Art Nouveau
styles.composition: Arched or circular halo behind a central figure or botanical. Whiplash curves running edge to edge. Decorative border integrated with the subject, never separate.
styles.typography: Hand-drawn organic display letterforms, letters conforming to the curve of the arch.
styles.texture: Litho-flat colour with fine ink contour lines.
styles.render_cues: art nouveau lithograph poster, sinuous whiplash curves, arched decorative halo, muted sage and ochre, fine ink contour lines, integrated ornamental border, hand-drawn organic display lettering

styles.name: Risograph
styles.composition: Two or three ink layers, deliberately misregistered by 2-6px. Overprint areas create a third colour. Flat shapes, no outline.
styles.typography: Chunky grotesque or a quirky indie serif, one size, sitting inside the composition rather than on top of it.
styles.texture: Visible paper tooth, ink mottle, halftone dot in the mid-tones, slight roller streak.
styles.render_cues: risograph print, two-colour fluorescent pink and blue with yellow overprint, deliberate 4px misregistration, visible halftone dots, paper tooth texture, flat shapes without outlines, indie zine aesthetic

styles.name: Ukiyo-e / Japanese Woodblock
styles.composition: Flattened perspective. Strong diagonal of a wave, branch or roofline. Subject cropped by the frame edge. Large area of flat sky. Cartouche panel for the title in one corner.
styles.typography: Vertical cartouche block. Latin type, if used, set small and vertical to mimic it.
styles.texture: Woodgrain bokashi gradient in the sky, visible key-block outline, hand-printed paper grain.
styles.render_cues: japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print, flattened perspective, bold key-block outline, indigo bokashi gradient sky, flat colour fields, cropped diagonal composition, vertical title cartouche, washi paper grain
styles.ip_note: Original Edo woodblocks are public domain. Verify the specific scan's rights.

styles.name: Minimalist Zen / High-Contrast Reduction
styles.composition: Two or three elements total. One perfect circle. Vast negative space. Subject reduced to pure silhouette. Nothing decorative survives.
styles.typography: None, or a single tiny word in the lower margin.
styles.texture: Perfectly flat, or a single subtle paper grain.
styles.render_cues: extreme minimalist poster, three colours only, one large flat circle, pure silhouette subject, vast negative space, high contrast black cream and blood red, zen composition, no gradients no detail
avoid: any text larger than 3% of canvas
styles.reads_at_250px_via: the circle — this style is engineered for thumbnails
styles.evidence: This is the profile of 'Red Moon Japan', a non-licensed entry in Displate's 2025 top 25.

styles.name: Vintage Botanical Plate
styles.composition: Single specimen, centred, floating on aged paper. Roots or stem cut cleanly. Small handwritten Latin binomial and plate number bottom-centre. Occasional inset detail of a seed or cross-section.
styles.typography: Small copperplate italic for the Latin name. Nothing else.
styles.texture: Aged paper, foxing spots, faint plate impression line.
styles.render_cues: antique botanical plate illustration, single centred specimen on aged cream paper, fine engraved linework with muted watercolour wash, handwritten latin binomial and plate number, subtle foxing, herbarium aesthetic
styles.set_note: Native set-of-3 style. Same plate treatment, three different specimens.

styles.name: Boho / Earthy Abstract
styles.composition: Arch or organic blob shapes. Layered overlapping forms. Off-centre balance. Large empty margin. Sometimes a single continuous line figure over the shapes.
styles.texture: Subtle canvas or plaster texture, soft matte edges.
styles.render_cues: boho abstract wall art, layered arch and organic blob shapes, terracotta ochre and warm neutral palette, soft matte canvas texture, off-centre composition, generous negative space, no text
styles.set_note: Strongest set-of-3 category on Etsy. Sell as families sharing one palette.

styles.name: Single-Line / Continuous Line Art
styles.composition: One unbroken line describing the subject. Line weight uniform. Subject occupies the centre 60%. Optional single flat colour shape offset behind the line.
styles.render_cues: continuous single line art, one unbroken uniform-weight black line, minimal abstract face or botanical form, one offset flat terracotta shape behind, bone white background, clean vector, no shading

styles.name: Dark Academia
styles.composition: Low-key, single pool of warm light. Heavy vignette. Objects arranged as a still life — books, candle, spectacles, dried flower. Or a classical bust in three-quarter shadow.
styles.typography: Small serif caps or a Latin motto, letterspaced, in the lower margin.
styles.texture: Oil-paint craquelure, aged varnish warmth, film grain.
styles.render_cues: dark academia still life, single warm candlelit pool of light, heavy vignette, aged oil painting craquelure, stacked antique books and classical bust, deep browns and oxblood, small letterspaced latin serif motto
styles.warning: Displate rejects very dark overall compositions. Keep a clear luminance range for that platform.

styles.name: Cottagecore
styles.composition: Soft gouache scene. Cosy interior or meadow. Warm diffuse light, no harsh shadow. Hand-drawn imperfect edges. Often a small animal doing something domestic.
styles.typography: Handwritten script if any, small, in a corner.
styles.texture: Gouache brush grain, soft paper tooth, coloured-pencil edge.
styles.render_cues: cottagecore gouache illustration, soft warm diffuse light, muted sage butter and dusty rose palette, hand-painted imperfect edges, cosy pastoral scene, visible brush grain, gentle storybook charm

styles.name: Retro-Futurism / 70s Sci-Fi Paperback
styles.composition: Vast scale contrast — a tiny figure against an enormous planet, arch or structure. Low horizon. Concentric or radiating background. Airbrushed gradient sky.
styles.typography: Wide rounded 70s sans, sometimes with an inline stripe. Small tagline beneath.
styles.texture: Airbrush spray grain, star speckle, subtle print halftone.
styles.render_cues: 1970s sci-fi paperback cover illustration, tiny lone figure dwarfed by enormous ringed planet, airbrushed gradient sky, burnt orange and deep space navy, concentric rays, star speckle grain, wide rounded 70s sans title
styles.evidence: Matches the 'Space Fantasy Landscape' and 'Moon Trip' profile in Displate's 2025 top 25.

styles.name: Linocut / Block Print
styles.composition: One or two inks only. Bold carved shapes. Visible gouge marks and chatter in the solid areas. Subject filling the frame. Hand-cut irregular border edge.
styles.typography: Carved-look caps, deliberately imperfect, if used at all.
styles.texture: Ink squeeze at the edges, uneven coverage, paper fibre showing through.
styles.render_cues: linocut block print, single deep green ink on cream paper, bold carved shapes with visible gouge chatter, uneven hand-pressed ink coverage, paper fibre texture, folk art motif, irregular hand-cut border

styles.name: Y2K Chrome / Early Internet
styles.composition: Floating chrome 3D object over a gradient mesh sky. Lens-flare star sparkles. Bubble or blob framing. Deliberately overloaded but centred.
styles.typography: Bubble/blobby display or a squished techno sans with chrome bevel and hard drop shadow.
styles.texture: Chrome specular highlights, glossy bevel, low-res JPEG artefacting as a deliberate effect, pixel dither.
styles.render_cues: Y2K chrome aesthetic, glossy liquid chrome 3D object floating over airbrushed gradient mesh sky, lens flare star sparkles, bubble display type with hard bevel, aqua and hot pink, deliberate low-res jpeg artefacts

styles.name: Public-Domain Master Fusion
styles.composition: Take a public-domain masterwork's composition and insert one modern or unexpected motif that belongs to the buyer's identity — a cat, a game controller silhouette, a houseplant. The intervention must be small and witty, never a collage.
styles.typography: None, or a tiny caption in the lower margin.
styles.texture: Match the source medium — impasto oil, woodblock grain, or engraving line.
styles.render_cues: oil painting in the manner of a public domain post-impressionist masterwork, thick swirling impasto brushwork, luminous cobalt and cadmium yellow, one small witty modern subject integrated into the classic composition
styles.ip_note: Verify public-domain term in your selling jurisdictions and use verified open-access scans (Met, Rijksmuseum, NYPL, Smithsonian, Library of Congress). A modern photograph of a public-domain work can carry its own rights. Never 'in the style of' a living artist.
styles.evidence: 'Starry Night and the Cat' charted at #13 in Displate's 2025 top 25 against an otherwise licensed-IP field.

styles.name: Bold Character Humour
styles.composition: One animal or character, front-on or three-quarter, filling 70% of the frame, making direct eye contact with the viewer. Flat background, single colour. Expression does all the work.
styles.typography: None, or one short word in a heavy display face at the very bottom.
styles.texture: Flat with clean linework, optional light paper grain.
styles.render_cues: bold flat illustration of a single animal filling the frame, direct deadpan eye contact with viewer, exaggerated judgemental expression, flat single-colour background, clean confident linework, limited pop palette
styles.reads_at_250px_via: the face — engineered for direct eye contact at thumbnail size
styles.evidence: 'Judgmental Duck' was Displate's #1 best-selling original (non-licensed) design of 2025.

styles.name: Celestial / Antique Chart
styles.composition: Circular chart centred with a wide ornamental margin. Fine hairline grid and radial divisions. Constellation figures drawn as faint engraved line overlays. Corner cartouches.
styles.typography: Small engraved copperplate serif for labels and the Latin legend.
styles.texture: Aged parchment, plate impression, fine engraving hatch.
styles.render_cues: antique engraved celestial star chart, circular map centred on aged parchment, fine hairline radial grid, gold constellation linework, engraved copperplate latin labels, ornamental corner cartouches, plate impression texture
